title: COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION archetype contract: the stage-archetype plugin interface, fixture unit, hidden rule
_source: docs/features/COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION/plan.md ### G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1); fixture unit shape from docs/features/COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION/design.md (Children, COMP-STAGE-GRADING)
_changelog: 2026-10-20 G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): first version. Plugin interface as a descriptor plus method table, fixture unit, oracle result, hidden-material rule, version-bump rule.
2026-10-22 COMP-STAGE-GRADING-3-INTEG: rules.runnerData names the module data the stage runner reads (hiddenPath, scenario, fixture|fixturePath, oracleName).
description: Archetype modules are JavaScript, so the interface is expressed as a descriptor schema (the data an archetype exports) plus a methods table (the callable surface a loader must find). Validate by pointing at one of $defs (examples[].validatesAgainst).

rules.runnerData: Next to the descriptor and methods, a stage archetype module exports the data lib/experiment-stage.js reads, under exactly these names: `hiddenPath` (absolute path outside the workspace, passed to oracle as `hidden`; required, the runner refuses an archetype without it and refuses a run whose workspace contains it), `scenario` (the prompt-safe fixture unit, no gold, passed to buildInput and prompt; null is allowed), `fixture` or `fixturePath` (hashed into fixtureDigest; one required), `oracleName` (optional, defaults to the id). Module-internal names (for example hiddenDir) are not part of the contract.
rules.hiddenNeverInWorkspace: `hidden` material (golden tests, planted bugs, mutants, answer keys) is never copied into the workspace before the oracle runs. oracle(workspace, hidden, artifacts) receives it by path outside the workspace; buildInput(workspace, scenario) and prompt(scenario) never see it.
rules.versionBump: Any change to an oracle or to its hidden material bumps `version`. That `version` is the `oracleVersion` recorded on every run and row, and part of compatKey.
rules.oracleCannotRun: An oracle that cannot run (for example the hidden suite fails to start) returns oracleError (a string) and accuracy null, never accuracy 0. Admission excludes such runs (registry-contract.json $defs.admittedRun).
rules.judged: judged is true for the rubric/panel stages design and plan, false for every other stage.
rules.loader: G3 owns lib/archetypes/index.js (loadArchetype). An unknown id is refused with ARCHETYPE_UNKNOWN (stage-run-contract.json rules.refusals).

methodTable.description: The callable surface every archetype module must export, in this order. Returned values are validated by the schemas named in `returns`.

descriptor.description: The data an archetype exports next to its methods: {id, stage, runner, judged, version} plus the method table. judged is true exactly for design and plan.

fixtureUnit.description: One {context, task, gold, task_type} unit (design.md). gold is the answer key and lives with the hidden material, never in the workspace.

hiddenRule.description: Machine-checkable statement of the hidden rule, recorded by the harness for each oracle call.

oracleResult.description: What oracle() returns. oracleError non-null means accuracy is null (never 0); otherwise accuracy is a number in 0..1.
